ÉLAN / YOUR QUESTIONS

A few things,
made clear.

What is known about the second edition, what is still being planned, and where to find the first-edition record.

ÉTHE NEXT CHAPTER

Crisis Command will be the only flagship. Cent$ible remains part of the 2026 archive and will not continue in the second edition.

Dates and venue have not been announced. The September 2026 dates and SGIS Mulshi venue belong to the first edition.

Registration and payments for the second edition are not open. Archived pass prices are not second-edition prices.

Eligibility, team size and the detailed format for the second edition will be announced before registration. The first-edition rules remain available for reference.

Yes, you can start a school enquiry now. Share your estimated delegation size and coordinator details on the school enquiry page.

Start with the volunteer enquiry or contact the team about a partnership. Roles and arrangements are agreed separately.

Yes. It securely saves your enquiry for the organising team. An enquiry does not reserve a place or create a participant account.

The 2026 archive contains the programme, event formats, photos and policies. Read the original-edition FAQs for historical answers.
